notablePrerequisites: Tana has power five or greater, does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tana.
Tana triggers, creating at least five 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability five times by sacrificing five Saprolings, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If Tana has power six or greater, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.
